task.title: Handle raw and unknown settings
task.shortdesc: Inspect imported unknown keys and raw-fallback values without losing them accidentally.

prereq.p: Open Review mode or a raw/unknown filtered list in All Settings.

context.p: Raw and unknown settings may come from import, schema differences, or values BPM cannot model visually. Treat them as preservation and review items, not routine edits.

step.cmd: Filter or open Review items for raw, unknown, or imported settings.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Inspect the raw value, source, validation state, and schema channel.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Decide whether to preserve, remove, reset, or inspect the value in JSON Editor.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Save only after confirming the value should remain or be removed.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: Raw and unknown values are preserved or removed intentionally.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the value might be important, export or compare the profile before removing it.
